comment_text.value: Your idea of a slim mic mask for dictation in public is intriguing, especially since you mentioned using Wispr Flow for dictation. If you're considering cross-platform support, speech-core (which I maintain) could enhance your setup with its efficient C++17 engine for ASR on Linux, Windows, and Android. https://github.com/soniqo/speech-core

story_title.value: Ask HN: Would you use a soundproof mic mask to dictate to AI in public?

comment_text: Your idea of a slim mic mask for dictation in public is intriguing, especially since you mentioned using Wispr Flow for dictation.
